findings.title: parseBody breaks after prior c.req.formData() call
findings.why_it_matters: A handler or middleware that calls `await c.req.formData()` and later `await c.req.parseBody()` worked at base, but now fails. For multipart it throws `TypeError: Failed to parse body as FormData.` (HTTP 500). For urlencoded it quietly returns garbage keys such as `{"------formdata-undici-...\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name": ...}`. parseFormData now always calls `arrayBuffer()`. When only `formData` is cached, HonoRequest#cachedBody rebuilds the bytes with `new Response(formData).arrayBuffer()`, which re-serializes them as multipart with a new boundary. bufferToFormData then parses those bytes against the original request's Content-Type, whose boundary or media type no longer matches. Reusing `bodyCache.formData` when it is present fixes this. validator.ts:115 already does exactly that for the same cache.
findings.suggested_fix: In parseFormData, before reading the ArrayBuffer, short-circuit on an existing cache, mirroring validator.ts:115-116: `if (request instanceof HonoRequest && request.bodyCache.formData) { const cached = await request.bodyCache.formData; return convertFormDataToBodyData<T>(cached, options) }`. Otherwise keep the new arrayBuffer + bufferToFormData path. Add a regression test: `await c.req.formData(); await c.req.parseBody()` for both multipart and urlencoded bodies.
evidence: src/utils/body.ts:126 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()
src/request.ts:228-235 -- const anyCachedKey = Object.keys(bodyCache)[0]; if (anyCachedKey) { return (bodyCache[anyCachedKey]).then((body) => { ... return new Response(body)[key]() }) }
src/validator/validator.ts:115-116 -- if (c.req.bodyCache.formData) { formData = await c.req.bodyCache.formData  (existing pattern that reuses the cache)

Empirical (esbuild+node scratch, app handler `await c.req.formData(); return c.json(await c.req.parseBody())`): HEAD multipart -> 500 'Failed to parse body as FormData.'; HEAD urlencoded -> 200 with key '------formdata-undici-...Content-Disposition: form-data; name'; BASE 9728702 -> 200 {"message":"hello"} for both

residual_risks: parseBody no longer calls `Request.formData()` on raw Request inputs; it reads `arrayBuffer()` and re-parses. Callers or tests that stub or override `formData()` on the Request passed to parseBody will see that stub bypassed. The PR's own test had to drop its `vi.spyOn(req, 'formData')` for this reason. This is an observable behavior change (Hyrum's Law) for a public util, and neither the PR nor any docs mention it.
testing_gaps: No test covers calling `c.req.formData()` (or anything else that caches only `formData`) before `c.req.parseBody()`. That is the ordering the new arrayBuffer-based path breaks.
